verdict.rationale: Pipedream exposes a marketplace of per-app MCP servers, so comparing servers by quality signals is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows tool counts per app (e.g. "46 actions · 4 triggers") and general observability claims. Neither is a published quality signal such as usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges, so no evidence supports this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges
